name: Bhagavad Gita 5.29
group: The Gita on duty and offering
text:
भोक्तारं यज्ञतपसां सर्वलोकमहेश्वरम् ।
सुहृदं सर्वभूतानां ज्ञात्वा मां शान्तिमृच्छति ॥
meaning: One who knows me as the enjoyer of every offering and discipline, the great lord of all worlds and the friend of all beings, attains peace.
purpose: Reflection on peace through recognising the divine as friend of all beings.
when: At the close of a practice.
